qualitative.gate_2_reason: Over 85-90% of group revenue is generated across developing Asian markets (Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, China, Indonesia) outside rule-of-law Western markets, failing the Western revenue standard.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Market expansion services specialist derives 85-90%+ of total group sales from developing and emerging Asian economies, failing the Western market geographic resilience standard. Thin ~3% operating margins leave the business vulnerable to principal insourcing and regional macro volatility.
